metadata.title: MCP-Context-Forge AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from MCP-Context-Forge Governance Benchmark

components.title: MCP-Context-Forge
components.description: AI/ML component for MCP-Context-Forge with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure MCP tool registry is complete and approved

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Maintain a centralized registry of all MCP tools configured in Context Forge, including owner, business purpose, connected systems, data sensitivity, and approval status. Require formal risk and security review before a new tool or integration can be enabled in any environment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: MCP tool registry completeness (%), Approved tool coverage (%), Unapproved tool detection count

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Registry completeness = (Number of MCP tools recorded / Number of MCP tools discovered from configs and logs) × 100. Approved tool coverage = (Approved tools / Total active tools) × 100. Unapproved tool detection = count of tools invoked that are not present in registry.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure MCP tool registry completeness and approval coverage are both ≥ 99%

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Governance inventory analogue to HF model inventory; required for mapping risks to specific MCP tools.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure MCP tools follow least-privilege permission model

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define fine-grained permissions for each MCP tool (read, write, delete, network, secrets) and ensure Context Forge policies only grant the minimum set of actions required for each use case. Prohibit tools that can arbitrarily execute shell commands or unrestricted network calls unless explicitly justified and approved.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Tools with explicit permission profiles (%), High-risk tools with additional approvals (%), Privilege escalation incidents

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Permission profile coverage = (Tools with explicit permission manifests / Total tools) × 100. High-risk tools approval = (High-risk tools with documented approval / Total high-risk tools) × 100. Privilege escalation incidents = count of investigations where tool had more rights than documented.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure 100% of MCP tools have explicit permission profiles and 0 undocumented high-risk tools

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Aligns with excessive agency and OWASP LLM “Excessive Agency” risk; complements HF safety metrics.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure strict context and tenancy isolation in Context Forge

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Implement hard isolation boundaries so that prompts, tool outputs, and intermediate MCP context from one tenant, workspace, or conversation cannot be accessed by another. Enforce tenant-scoped encryption keys, per-tenant storage, and explicit routing rules for all tool calls and retrieved documents.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Cross-tenant access attempts blocked, Context isolation test pass rate, Data leakage incidents

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run automated cross-tenant access tests; pass rate = (Successful isolation tests / Total isolation tests) × 100. Data leakage incidents = number of confirmed cross-tenant exposure events in a period.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Membership inference / data leakage benchmarks (e.g., training data extraction rate)

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure 100% isolation test pass rate and 0 confirmed cross-tenant leakage incidents

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Conceptually related to HF privacy metrics (membership inference, extraction), extended to multi-tenant MCP routing.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Credential and secret leakage via tools

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure MCP tool credentials are managed via secure vaults and never exposed to models

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Store all MCP tool credentials (API keys, database passwords, cloud tokens) in an approved secrets manager. Ensure Context Forge passes short-lived tokens directly to tools without placing secrets into model prompts, system messages, or logs. Implement automated scanning for secrets in prompts, tool inputs, tool outputs, and conversation logs.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Secrets in prompts detected, Secrets in logs detected, Secret rotation interval (days)

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run secret-scanning over stored prompts, tool payloads, and logs. Record count of findings by location. Rotation interval = average days between credential rotations for MCP tools.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure 0 persistent secrets in prompts or logs and maximum rotation interval of 90 days

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Supports IBM Risk Atlas “Confidential information in data/prompt” and mitigates training data memorization risks.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Prompt injection via external tools and resources

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Context Forge mediates and sanitizes tool outputs before reuse as model context

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Implement an intermediate sanitization and policy-enforcement layer between MCP tool outputs (web search, file systems, code execution, databases) and the model context. Detect and neutralize instructions embedded in tool responses (indirect prompt injection), enforce content-type schemas, and strip or neutralize model-directed language.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Indirect prompt injection detection rate (%), False positive rate (%), Tool-response schema violation rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Use attack suites such as JailbreakBench and custom corpora of poisoned tool responses. Detection rate = (Detected injections / Total injected responses) × 100. False positive rate = (Benign responses flagged / Total benign responses) × 100. Schema violation rate = (Responses failing schema validation / Total responses) × 100.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Jailbreak success rate, Harmful output rate (HarmBench)

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure ≥ 90% indirect injection detection, ≤ 5% false positives, and near-zero schema violations

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Extends HF jailbreak and safety benchmarks to tool-mediated attack paths common in MCP architectures.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure full traceability of MCP tool call graph per conversation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Log a structured graph of all MCP tool invocations, inputs (with privacy-safe redaction), outputs, timing, and calling model prompts for every Context Forge conversation. Support reconstruction of exact decision path used to produce a given answer or side effect.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Conversations with complete tool trace (%), Average trace reconstruction time, Missing log segment count

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Trace completeness = (Conversations where full tool graph can be reconstructed / Conversations sampled) × 100. Average reconstruction time measured from request to available trace. Missing segments = count of gaps in logged tool chains.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure ≥ 99% conversations have complete tool traces with reconstruction time under 2 minutes

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Provides infrastructure needed to support model-level explainability (e.g., SHAP, LIME) in multi-tool workflows.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Harmful or toxic content from tool-augmented flows

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure safety and toxicity detection on final outputs from Context Forge

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run all final user-facing responses from Context Forge through safety classifiers (toxicity, self-harm, violence, hate, illegal advice). Incorporate signals from both the base model and post-processing classifiers. Block, redact, or escalate responses that exceed defined harm thresholds.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Toxic output rate (%), High-severity safety incident count, Classifier coverage (% of responses scanned)

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Toxic output rate = (Responses with safety score above threshold / Total responses) × 100. Coverage = (Responses scanned by classifiers / Total responses) × 100. High-severity incidents = count of blocked or escalated responses tagged as critical.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: ToxiGen toxicity scores, RealToxicityPrompts continuation scores, HarmBench attack success rate

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure ≥ 99% coverage, toxic output rate < 0.5%, and 0 unmitigated high-severity incidents

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Directly aligns with HF toxicity and safety benchmarks applied to the combined model+tool stack.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Unreliable or opaque external knowledge sources

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure provenance and trust scoring for all external content injected via MCP tools

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For retrieval-augmented generation and external tool calls (web search, document stores, enterprise APIs), attach provenance metadata (source system, document ID, retrieval time) and a trust score to each chunk injected into the model context. Expose this metadata to downstream logging and user-facing explanations where appropriate.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Retrieved chunks with provenance (%), Average trust score, Responses with source citations (%)

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Provenance coverage = (Retrieved chunks with complete metadata / Total retrieved chunks) × 100. Source citation coverage = (Responses that include user-visible citations / Total RAG responses) × 100.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: N/A - provenance and citation metric; related to source-attribution benchmarks

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure ≥ 95% provenance coverage and ≥ 80% of RAG responses expose citations to users

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Mitigates IBM Risk Atlas “Unreliable source attribution” and supports groundedness evaluation.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination detection using tool-grounded consistency checks

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use retrieved documents and structured tool outputs as ground truth signals to detect hallucinations in Context Forge responses. For claims not backed by retrieved evidence or tools, downgrade confidence, add disclaimers, or request clarification from the user.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Hallucination rate on grounded questions, Evidence-backed statement percentage, Detected unsupported claims

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Evaluate on fact-checking benchmarks and internal QA sets. Hallucination rate = (Factually incorrect statements / Total factual statements) × 100. Evidence-backed percentage = (Statements with explicit supporting evidence from tools / Total statements) × 100.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure hallucination rate < 10% on fact-based tasks and evidence-backed statements ≥ 85%

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Extends groundedness tests to multi-tool workflows where evidence can come from MCP tools.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Resource exhaustion and abusive tool use

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure per-user and per-tool rate limits with anomaly detection

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Configure Context Forge to enforce rate limits and quotas per user, tenant, and MCP tool to prevent resource exhaustion, inadvertent denial of service, or large-scale data scraping via tools. Augment with anomaly detection on call patterns to identify automated abuse or credential compromise.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Rate limit violations, Blocked abusive sessions, Average calls per user and tool

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Track per-identity call counts over rolling windows (minute, hour, day). Log and alert on requests above policy limits. Rate limit violations = count of blocked calls due to limits.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure rate limits in place for 100% of external-facing tools and zero successful resource-exhaustion incidents

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Mitigates OWASP LLM “Model Denial of Service” and supports NIST robustness goals for deployed AI.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure human review for high-risk MCP action plans

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For MCP workflows that can trigger high-stakes actions (financial transfers, access changes, production changes, sensitive communications), require explicit human approval of the model-generated plan and tool calls before execution. Log approvals and overrides for later audit.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: High-risk workflows with HITL enabled (%), Approval vs override rate, Average review time

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = (High-risk workflows that require human approval / Total identified high-risk workflows) × 100. Override rate = (Rejected or modified plans / Reviewed plans) × 100. Review time averaged from plan creation to decision.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: N/A - governance and operational control metric

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure 100% of identified high-risk MCP workflows require human approval

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Complements HF model cards “Intended Use / Out-of-Scope Use” sections with concrete control on agentic actions.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Incorrect or incomplete risk testing for MCP setups

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure comprehensive AI risk testing for each MCP-Context-Forge configuration

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define a standard AI risk test suite for MCP-Context-Forge configurations covering accuracy, robustness (prompt and tool injection), privacy, fairness, explainability, & misuse. Require execution and documented results of this suite before promoting configurations to production.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Risk test coverage (% of risk categories tested), Test pass rate, Open risk findings per configuration

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = (Risk categories with at least one executed test / Total defined risk categories) × 100. Pass rate = (Tests passed / Total tests run) × 100. Open findings = count of unresolved test findings per configuration.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Aggregated from HF evaluation suites (HELM, HarmBench, ToxiGen, BBQ, etc.)

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure ≥ 90% risk coverage and 0 Critical / High open findings before production

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Uses HF and other benchmarks as underlying tests while governing them at the configuration level.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for MCP-Context-Forge
